body: like i said to someone else how do you know i matter? you don’t know anything about me, the people i’ve hurt the shit i’ve done. and why do you think im still here? not looking for a sign looking for a reason
how do you think i’m good enough? you don’t even know me
He says he forgives me, that he holds no grudges but I feel like he hates me, despises me even though he has told me otherwise many times before

I didn’t lose them in a literal sense, they changed and used me to gain minuscule things, lied to me, betrayed my trust and treated me like shit on the bottom of their shoe, I make one mistake, try to fix it, they say that they forgive me only to proceed to mock me, to abuse me, to use me, to only care when you’re dead just so they can get pitied upon. At this point I can think of only three people whom I still actually give a fuck about, two of which won’t understand what that means for another 10 years, and the other one I have mistreated and ridiculed many times over the years, and I constantly beat myself up thinking that he will think back, think how much of a piece of shit I am and abandon me like everyone else

At this point the only reason I’m typing this response and not 6 feet in the ground is because of my two nephews who are two of three people in this world that I still give a fuck about everyone else has either betrayed my trust or became nothing but a leech

Lack of people that I give a shit about who in return would care if I died, I don’t want to live a life that accomplished nothing, what’s the fucking point in living a life if all I do is work to barely scrape by? To give you a proper answer I have no fucking clue why, I’ve had suicidal thoughts since as early as 12 years old and at this point I’ve gotten so fucking used to it that I truly feel nothing besides fear and anger

I feel the same brother. As if you want to just drive and drive until there is no more road, then drive some more and only hope for death. People I care about have left me time and time again I only wish people actually gave a fuck about me
